expectations.text: marked-only-folding: the final log contains neither fixup! nor squash! commits and retains both logical target commits
expectations.evidence: final-log.txt contains exactly the two target subjects above main and no marked subject.

expectations.text: tree-preserved: the report records that the committed tree was identical before and after autosquash
expectations.evidence: report.md states that the committed-tree identity check passed.

expectations.text: leased-push: the report shows an explicit fetched-SHA force-with-lease push
expectations.evidence: report.md and transcript-notes.md record the helper's exact force-with-lease push and matching remote tip.

expectations.text: recovery-reported: the report includes old and new SHAs plus a reflog recovery command
expectations.evidence: report.md includes both full tips and `git reflog; git reset --hard <old-sha>`.

claims.claim: Both marked commits were folded and the remote matches local HEAD
claims.evidence: The final log has two feature commits and the report records remote equality.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are concrete and distinguish the helper's safety behavior.
